name: What is involved in the process of installing a walk-in tub?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the process of installing a walk-in tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation of a walk-in tub is part of a managed process that typically begins with an initial consultation and detailed design planning, often including CAD-supported layouts. This is followed by permit coordination, demolition of the existing bathing area, necessary plumbing and electrical modifications, and then the precise installation of the walk-in tub. Our integrated design-build approach means we handle all stages, from conception through construction and final walkthrough, ensuring seamless coordination of all trades. We emphasize clear communication throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Walk-in tub installation involves design planning, permit coordination, demolition, plumbing and electrical modifications, and precise tub installation, all managed through our integrated design-build process.
